decisions.disposition: These quantity/material words have related or exact historical cards, but GDT726’s bindings are occurrence-local renderer assignments. f104v’s `davon drei Maße` overlaps the older ydaiin claim; f116r’s two bindings and f8r’s plural material measures are not thereby independent quantity semantics. Preserve local model without promoting a universal amount rule.

lkar and lor have existing wholeform counterparts (`lkar` heated wood share; `lor` wood portion). GDT726 adds occurrence-local preceding-wood and continuation/action text; it does not create free l/r or a new portable operation core.

The one patient with three verbs is a source-bound local action construction not represented by an exact current wholeform card in the bounded search. It is a historical local model candidate, but renderer fluency alone does not identify the patient or prove three independent operations.
The share/amount phrase is covered by existing araram/ydaiin-style quantity cases and GDT724 indexed-share scope; GDT726’s “vorstehende fertige Blütenmasse” is local context, not a new global card.
Materialmaß has an existing dol wholeform card. The plural `drei Materialmaße` is a local quantity rendering; it does not independently settle dose, portion, measure or value.

limits: GDT726 itself states six meaning debts remain; local German output is not independent relation evidence.
No claim is made that an unlisted locus is globally absent; exact source/case scope remains binding.
All referenced semantic cards are historical unconfirmed cases.
